name: updateLocationsAdvanced
description: Changes several locations at once, up to 50.

locations.description: The locations to change and what to change on each, up to 50 at a time.

locationId.description: The location's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The location's new name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newSubtitle.description: The short line shown under its name. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAddress.description: The location's new street address. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newLatitude.description: Where it is on the map from now on, north to south, from -90 to 90. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newLongitude.description: Where it is on the map from now on, east to west, from -180 to 180. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newFormattedAddress.description: The full address as the map shows it. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAddressAlias.description: The custom name shown for the address on the map. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newListImage.description: The picture shown for it in lists, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newDescription.description: The location's new formatted description, as HTML. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newImages.description: The pictures shown on its page, in order; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep the current ones, or pass an empty list to remove them.

newCategories.description: The categories it belongs to from now on, each by name with a subcategory after an arrow, such as "Food -> Pizza, Drinks". Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newMarkerType.description: How it is marked on the map from now on. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newMarkerImage.description: The picture used as its map marker when the marker type is image, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newMarkerColor.description: The color of its circle marker, such as rgba(253,35,5,1). Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newShowCategory.description: Whether its categories show on its page. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newShowOpeningHours.description: Whether its opening hours show. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newShowPriceRange.description: Whether its price range shows. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newShowStarRating.description: Whether its star rating shows. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newPriceRange.description: How pricey it is. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newPriceCurrency.description: The currency sign shown with its price range. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newActionItems.description: The buttons on its page, in order; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep the current ones, or pass an empty list to remove them.

newPinned.description: Pin it to the top of the introduction screen, or unpin it; up to three locations can be pinned. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newMondayHours.description: When it is open on Mondays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newTuesdayHours.description: When it is open on Tuesdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newWednesdayHours.description: When it is open on Wednesdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newThursdayHours.description: When it is open on Thursdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newFridayHours.description: When it is open on Fridays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newSaturdayHours.description: When it is open on Saturdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

newSundayHours.description: When it is open on Sundays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it as it is.

callback.description: Runs when all the locations are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as an entry missing what it needs or naming something that doesn't exist.

result.description: How each of the locations went.

locations.description: One result per entry, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which entry this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The id of what was changed, if it was.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
